_comment: Which identity and contact values this exact PDF must show. Copy into the ResumeVersion directory as identity-contract.json, keep only the fact IDs this artifact actually carries, then record the confirmation with `artifact_integrity_audit.py confirm-contract`. Editing this file afterwards invalidates that confirmation, because the record pins this file's hash. Each list must name at least one fact: declaring that nothing has to appear would be the easiest green light and would look identical to a resume that carries everything. Without a confirmed contract the audit reports no_contract and judges no identity value, since a resume legitimately omits a former employer, a second degree or an address it never claimed to show.
artifact_sha256: <sha256 of the exact resume file this contract governs>
candidate_profile_sha256: <the version's candidate_profile_sha256, not whichever snapshot is active now>
